edges.rationale: Next.js is a React meta-framework; building Next.js apps requires writing React components and using hooks.
React and Next.js are JavaScript/TypeScript libraries executing on the JavaScript runtime.
TypeScript is a strict syntactical superset of JavaScript that compiles down to JavaScript.
React component development requires foundational JavaScript (ES6+, DOM, closures).
Spring Boot applications are written in Java and execute on the Java Virtual Machine.
FastAPI is a Python web framework built on standard Python type hints.
Django is a high-level Python web framework written entirely in Python.
Flask is a Python micro-framework requiring Python proficiency.
Express is an HTTP framework designed specifically for the Node.js runtime.
NestJS is a server-side framework running on Node.js.
NestJS heavily leverages TypeScript decorators, interfaces, and dependency injection.
Deploying services onto managed Amazon EKS clusters does not demonstrate Docker containerization or container daemon internals.
Using a cloud-managed Kubernetes service (EKS) does not imply proficiency in bare-metal Kubernetes architecture or cluster administration.
Managed service usage does not guarantee container runtime proficiency.
